title: Products with monthly income
blurb: Structures that pay out on a regular schedule instead of at maturity — useful if you need cash flow rather than growth.

title: Government-backed schemes
blurb: Issued or run by a government body. Different rules from bank deposits, and generally a longer lock-in.

title: Understand before you invest
blurb: Products where the fine print does most of the work: market-linked, conditional, or priced by an exchange.

title: Ways to start with small amounts
blurb: Options with a low entry point, so you can learn the mechanics without committing much.

title: Parking money for under a year
blurb: For money you will need soon. Prioritises access and stability over return.

title: Tax-saving structures
blurb: Products built around a tax deduction, usually with a lock-in attached. Confirm current rules before relying on any of it.
